title: SYMBIVELA OIDC Auth v1
description: Login-bootstrap endpoints for the backend-proxied OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE flow. The client_secret never leaves the server; the browser only exchanges the authorization code, its single-use state, and the PKCE code_verifier.

url.description: Absolute IdP authorization URL embedding the S256 code challenge and a fresh state nonce.

state.description: Single-use state nonce the caller must echo back with the code at exchange time.

code.description: Authorization code returned by the IdP redirect.

state.description: The state nonce issued by authorize-url; validated single-use server-side.

code_verifier.description: PKCE verifier derived from the S256 challenge sent at authorize time.

id_token.description: OIDC ID token; the browser stores it and sends it as Authorization: Bearer on API calls.

error.description: Error code: invalid_request, invalid_state, oidc_exchange_failed, rate_limited.
